AccountContact.description:
A contact of a provider's account, as the provider answers it, with whether the receiver holds the one-to-one
the account has with it and the mode that room was added in.

roomId.description: The one-to-one the account already has with the contact.

AccountMemberships.description: `GET /accounts/{account}/rooms`: the rooms an account is a member of in the console.

AccountNaming.description:
`PUT /accounts/{account}/identity`'s body: the name the account's record identity goes by from then, the same
field an account's words carry; none names nothing.

AccountPresence.description:
`PUT /accounts/{account}/presence`: an account's presence as the console draws it from its tabs; a null state
takes the console's word back.

lastSeenAt.description: Epoch milliseconds: the last moment a visible tab of the account reported.

AccountRoom.description:
A room a provider's account is in, as the provider answers it, with whether the receiver holds it and the mode
the receiver added it in.

held.description: Whether the receiver holds the room: its own, one it keeps a title or a message of, or one added.

mode.description: The mode the room was added in; null for a room not added.

privateTo.description: The one person of a one-to-one with the account.

AccountTyping.description: `POST /rooms/{roomId}/typing`: an account writing in a room's box in the console, or no longer.

AccountWords.description: `POST /rooms/{roomId}/words`: words an account said in the console, with the name it is shown by.

AddRoom.description:
`POST /rooms`: a room to add, on a chat service by its key, as that service numbers it, in a mode, under a title
where one is named.

AddedRoom.description:
The console room the receiver stood up for a supervisor it added: whether it took back one already standing
under the name, and what the owner is told of that.

AgentFigure.description: One agent's figures in a room.

AgentRoom.description:
`POST /rooms` with no chat service: an agent room on the record alone, answered by `supervisors`, its first
member the account `opened_by` names where one opens it.

defaultAnswerer.description: Whether it is the supervisor the receiver's default answerer setting names.

Answerers.description: `GET /rooms/{roomId}/answerers`: the room's default answerer, its voice, and every agent answering it.

began.description:
The moment the asking turn took its words, in epoch milliseconds: a turn begun at or before its
agent's reset point is refused.

from.description: The command or unit the words come through, which words handed to the room's supervisor name.

Audience.description:
Whom a room's reference may reach for a supervisor (`docs/receiver.md`, 「Whether someone outside the company
sits in a room」): `internal` where everyone in the room stands in the company of the supervisor's owner.

Avatar.description: One profile picture the archive keeps.

Avatars.description: The profile pictures kept, oldest taken first.

ChangeRoomArchive.description: `PUT /rooms/{roomId}/archive`: whether a room is to stand archived.

ChangeRoomMode.description: `PUT /rooms/{roomId}/registration`: the mode a room's registration is to stand in.

ChangeRoomTitle.description: `PUT /rooms/{roomId}/title`: the name a room on the record alone is to stand under.

ChangeRoomTone.description: `PUT /rooms/{roomId}/tone`: the tone layer a room is to stand in, one the deployment offers, or null for none.

ChangeSpeaker.description:
`PUT /rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}/speaker`: the agent a kept line standing under its own number in the
room is to be filed as.

ChooseProviders.description: A room's chat providers set whole: at least one, each once.

Compacting.description: A room whose session is folding.

Created.description: The id a created member answers with.

DefaultAnswerer.description: The default answerer setting: the supervisor that answers every room naming none.

Editing.description: The new words of the signed-in person's own message.

account.description: The account the act is for where the console acts for one; refused in another account's private room.

FileEntry.description: One of a message's files, by its place among them.

FileFill.description:
`POST /rooms/{roomId}/file-fills`: a pass over a room's placeholder rows, asking its chat service for their
files again.

dryRun.description: List the rows the pass would ask, and ask nothing.

rows.description: How many rows the pass may ask; null for the policy's default, and never more than its ceiling.

FileFills.description: `POST /rooms/{roomId}/file-fills`: the rows a pass reached, newest first.

unreached.description: Why the room's road could not be reached, where that ended the pass; null otherwise.

FileLimit.description: The largest file a room takes, and the chat service that declares it.

FillOutcome.description: What the chat service answered for one row a pass asked for.

oneOf.description: Files came back and were kept.
The platform would not give the files.

FilledFile.description: One file a filled row kept: its kind and the bytes the store holds of it.

kind.description: `image` for a picture, else the kind its kept row names.

outcome.description: What the service answered; null on a dry run.

reason.description: The service's own sentence, where it gave one.

Forgotten.description: What a delete of an agent's marks let go.

Forward.description:
A message forwarded into another room: the room it goes into, and the account that forwards it with the name it
is shown by, where the console forwards for one; the owner's where it names none.

account.description: The forwarding account, whose sender the copy stands under; refused into another account's private room.

name.description: The forwarding account's shown name, else the name its identity last went by.

ForwardedFrom.description: The message a forwarded copy stands for.

HandoffAsked.description:
A handoff the agency asks for ahead of a fresh session it opens for an agent that had one: why, and the room
whose session is asked where the agent keeps one in each room, and the room the line is told in; the cause that
line names, a `HandoverCause` kind, `other` where none is named, and the account key of the person who asked,
where one did. `clean` asks the session to consolidate and close with no handoff, so the fresh session opens on
no note; `ask` false asks no session at all and tells the room's line alone.

HandoffWritten.description: The handoff file a standing session wrote: where it stands and how long it is, in bytes.

HandoverAsked.description:
A handover asked for an agent's one session: why, in the asker's words, for the receiver's journal and the room's
line; the room that line goes to, and the account key of the person who asked, where the asking names them.

HandoverPending.description:
A handover written for an agent's one session, which its next turn carries out: the agent, and the reason the
replacement goes by.

Holding.description: One thing a unit holds of a room.

effect.description: `kept` where the rows stay, `warns` where the unit shows what it answers before the removal.

HookAnswer.description: What the agency reads from a hook the receiver serves.

Instruction.description: An instruction and how far it has gone.

InstructionCause.description: Whether somebody waits on an instruction (docs/wake.md, 「Quiet instructions」).

oneOf.description:
It answers something a room or the owner asked or set going, and opens the agent's turn by itself, on a
session past its cache lifetime too.

A record for the agent alone that nobody waits on, which waits for a round something else opens where the
session is past its cache lifetime.

InstructionChain.description: A row of a round's pipeline (docs/instruction.md, 「The round log」).

agentName.description: The supervisor's name, or `*` for the policy's default chain every supervisor follows until it sets one.

stages.description: The chain's stage names, in the order they are asked once the message stands; empty runs no stage.

InstructionChainSet.description: A supervisor's chain set by the console.

InstructionRequest.description: An instruction queued for an agent's session.

agentOnly.description: A record the agent reads and no room hears: a round carrying only such rows sends no message.

cause.description: Whether somebody waits on it: a room reply, the default, or housekeeping.

line.description:
A fixed line the room hears at once as the service's own as the row is written, its `code` and fields
(docs/codes.md, 「Fixed lines」): one a unit may ask for alone, `supply-closed`.

publisher.description:
The unit or source that published the row, kept with it and named in every turn it rides; a row naming none
is read by the first word of its kind.

ridesForGood.description: Whether it rides its room's rounds for good, opening no turn of its own.

InstructionState.description: How far an instruction has gone.

InstructionText.description:
A stage of the catalogue: its name, its text and whether the console set the text; the policy's text of it where
the console set one for a supervisor and the policy holds it too, null for a stage the console added.

InstructionTextSet.description: A question's text set by the console.

KeepMarks.description: The body that marks a room's messages read into an agent's book.

KeptFile.description: A file a message carried, as the record kept it.

KeptFixedLine.description:
A fixed line as a message keeps it: its code and the fields it carries, as the receiver's `docs/codes.md`,
「Fixed lines」, names them.

KeptLine.description:
Where a kept line stands: the room it was kept in, and its number there, none where no sentence could be made
of it.

KeptLineAsked.description:
A line another unit asks to be kept in an agent's owner's private room, in that room's record alone: the fixed
line, its `code` and its fields, which must be one a unit asks to be kept.

LetInAccounts.description: `POST /rooms/{roomId}/accounts`: each account asked as a member as it now stands, and those the call let in.

LetInSeveral.description: `POST /rooms/{roomId}/accounts`: the accounts let in, at least one and each once, and the account letting them in.

LetInUnit.description:
`POST /rooms/{roomId}/unit-accounts`: the organisation unit whose people are let in, by its number in the web
unit, and the account letting them in.

LetInUnitAccounts.description:
`POST /rooms/{roomId}/unit-accounts`: the unit as the web unit named it then, each of its people as a member of
the room as it now stands, and those the call let in.

LineReading.description:
A line's full reading: `making` while its script is written and the voice engine speaks it, `ready` once it
can be heard, and the engine's briefing, whose sound the engine serves.

briefingId.description: Null while the line's agent is still writing its script.

Live.description: The live board: the process's turns, folds and each room's queued message.

agentName.description:
The registration name of the agent whose words these are, set on a send the receiver archived itself and
null on a message that came in from a provider.

deletedAt.description: When the record kept the message's delete, its words cleared, in epoch milliseconds.

editedAt.description: When the record kept an edit of the message, in epoch milliseconds.

forwardedFrom.description: Where a copy the owner forwarded came from: the room, the message and who said it; null on any other message.

kind.description:
`sticker` for a sticker kept on the record, `thinking` for a thinking block a record holds as a message,
`fixed-line` for a fixed line the receiver said into the room itself and for a line a chat service handed
over, null for any other message.

line.description: On a message of kind `fixed-line`, the line it was said from; null on any other.

notCarried.description:
The chat services that did not carry an act on this message, each a `NotCarried`: it stands on the answer of
an act alone, and where there is nothing to name the field is left out.

pinnedAt.description: When the record kept the message pinned, in epoch milliseconds; null where it stands unpinned.

reactions.description: The reactions the record keeps on the message, in the order they were put there.

situation.description:
The room's situation note as the round that judged this message read it; null on a message no round judged
under one.

transcript.description: The words heard in a voice note; null on any other message and on one whose recording could not be heard.

voice.description:
The voice the send went out in (`bot-account`, `human-avatar`, `human-reader`), set beside `agentName` and
null on a message that came in from a provider.

voiceSeconds.description: How long a voice note's recording ran, in seconds; null on any other message.

voiceState.description: Whether a voice note was heard (`heard`) or could not be (`failed`); null on any other message.

MessageMetadata.description: What a chat service handed over beside a message, opaque to the receiver.

NotCarried.description:
One chat service that did not carry an act on a message: its key, the `reason` the act did not go there
(`no-copy` where it holds no number for the message, `no-service` where the room's list names a provider no
chat service stands under, `refused` where it turned the act down in every voice it has for the room), and the
service's own `detail` sentence where it gave one.

Notice.description: One notice a room was voiced.

NoticeSwitch.description: One notice switch moved, the kind named by the path.

NoticeSwitches.description:
The owner's private chat's two notice switches: the restart's notices, and the rest's line and its lifting's
notice.

Opening.description: One quiet instruction a round settled.

OwnNumber.description: The sender an agent's own words stand under in a room.

Owner.description: `GET /owner`: the deployment's owner as a sender, and the owner's private room.

OwnerInstruction.description: Words the owner typed for a room's session.

OwnerMessage.description: The owner's words typed on a screen.

OwnerSpoke.description: Whether the person is the owner, and whether the owner spoke in the span.

Page.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page10.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page11.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page12.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page13.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page2.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page3.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page4.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page5.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page6.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page7.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page8.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

Page9.description: A page of a collection: its members, and whether anything stands past the last of them.

before.description: How many of the room's pictures stand before the first one answered.

account.description: The account the act is for where the console acts for one; refused in another account's private room.
The account pinning; refused where the order pins or unpins another account's private room.

PinnedRooms.description: The pinned order as it now stands.

Pinning.description: A pin the signed-in person sets on a message, or takes off.

account.description: The account the act is for where the console acts for one; refused in another account's private room.

Pins.description: A room's pinned messages, newest pin first.

PipelineRound.description: One turn of a round, or its end.

kind.description:
`supervisor` (the agent's own judgement before a round), `turn` (the round's own turn), `arrived` (the closing
check), `audit` (the audit of the people the message answers) or `stage` (an instruction stage), or `end`.

loaded.description:
On the end, how many pieces the room's earlier rounds of the same session read in full (`attached` or
`read`), 0 for a session's first round in the room or a round on no session; null on every other row.

number.description:
From 1, the round's own turn first and then the check of the words that arrived meanwhile, the audit and each
stage in the order asked; 0 for the agent's own judgement before a round its open window alone let in.

outcome.description:
`answered`, `send`, `no-verdict`, `skip` or `failed` for a turn or check, and `pass` for a check whose
empty answer kept the message; `pass`, `revised` or `failed` for the audit and a stage; `message` or `skip`
for the end.

question.description: The row's name: the stage it ran, `arrived` for the closing check, `message` for the round's own turn.

reads.description: On the end, what the round read from the brain; empty on every other row.

session.description: On the end, the agency session the round's turn ran on, null where it ran on none; null on every other row.

versions.description:
On a turn's row whose turn spanned more than one turn of the agent's program, each of those turns' answers in
order, the row's answer built from them; empty on every other row.

PresenceState.description: Whether a person is reachable now: online, busy or not; away, signed in but idle; offline.

PromiseReading.description: Whether a text waits for something to happen first.

Provider.description:
A chat provider a room may be on: its key, what it is called, the verbs it performs, whether it lists the rooms
of its account, and the modes a room added on it may take, as it declares.

can.description: Every chat verb it declares it performs, by bmo-chat's names: one provider's own, whatever room it is on.

fileBytes.description: The largest file it takes, in bytes, as it declares; null where it declares none.

startsChats.description: Whether it starts a one-to-one with a contact.

startsGroups.description: Whether it starts a group of contacts under a title.

PublishedEvent.description: The event a process beside the receiver publishes.

QueuedMessage.description: The message a room queued for a turn.

Reacting.description:
One message, wherever it is answered.
A reaction the signed-in person puts on a message, by its emoji.

account.description: The account the act is for where the console acts for one; refused in another account's private room.

Reaction.description: A reaction the record keeps on a message: its emoji and who put it there, an agent's name or a person's number.

ReadMarkCount.description: How many of a room's messages an agent has marked.

ReadMarkCounts.description: The body that counts the messages past an agent's marks.

Room.description: One room, as the room list and one room's read answer it.

lastMessageAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; null where the room holds no message.

listened.description:
Whether the room stands on the listen list, the rooms the owner allowed with his allow command and has not
denied since; always true for the owner's private room.

mode.description: The mode the room was added in; null for a room never added.

privateOf.description:
The account whose private room this is: a BMO's own room on the record, or the owner's private room; null for
every other room, a group room every other member has left among them.

sealed.description:
Whether the room is a private room whose account is not known yet, so no account writes in it: the owner's
private room before an account is linked to his sender.

senders.description: The people that have stood as a sender in the room.

supervisors.description:
The supervisors the room names to answer it, in name order; empty where it names none and the default
answerer answers it.

workRoom.description: The room where work filed from this one is told.

RoomAccount.description: A member of a room by account: who let it in and when, both null for a private room's own account.

RoomAddition.description:
The body of `POST /rooms`: a room of a chat service's account, a conversation the service starts, or an agent
room on the record alone.

RoomAnswerers.description: Every room with its agents answering it.

RoomArchive.description: `GET /rooms/{roomId}/archive`: whether a room is archived and locked.

archivedAt.description: When the room was archived, in milliseconds; null while it is open.

archivedBy.description: Who archived it; null while it is open.

RoomAudience.description: `GET /rooms/{roomId}/audience`: a room's audience for a supervisor.

RoomHolder.description: A unit declaring what it holds of a room.

RoomLeaders.description: `GET /rooms/{roomId}/leaders`: the accounts that lead a room, owning a supervisor it names.

RoomMember.description: One person in a room, as the room's own chat service lists them.

name.description: What the room calls the person.

person.description: The sender number the room's messages carry for the person; null where the service gave the person none.

statusMessage.description: The person's status line, or null where the service gave none.

RoomMembers.description: The people in a room, as the room's own chat service lists them, whole.

RoomMode.description: What a room added is to the agents: answered as the user, or the user alone.

oneOf.description: The room's agents answer it, in the account of the person the provider reads.
The user alone: the room is kept and no agent is woken in it.

RoomProviders.description:
The chat providers a room is on, by key in order, whether its list was set rather than read off what the room
holds, and the largest file the room takes.

fileLimit.description:
The smallest limit any chat service on the list declares; null where none declares one and the room takes a
file of any size.

RoomReadCount.description: A room and how many of its messages an agent has not marked.

RoomRegistration.description: `GET /rooms/{roomId}/registration`: what the receiver holds of a room's registration.

chosen.description: Whether the list was set rather than read off what the room holds.

mode.description: The mode the room was added in; null for a room never added.

providers.description: The chat providers the room is on, in order.

readOnly.description: Whether every chat service on the room's list reads it in the owner's account alone.

readOnlyBy.description: The chat services on the list that read the room in the owner's account alone, in list order.

RoomSince.description: One room's moment to count from.

RoomSituation.description:
A room's situation note as it stands, with when it last changed in epoch milliseconds; both null where the room
has no note yet.

RoomSupervisors.description: A room's whole list of supervisors.

RoomTone.description: `GET /rooms/{roomId}/tone`: the tone layer a room is set to, and the layers the deployment offers.

tone.description: The layer's name; null where the room is set to none.

tones.description: The layers a room may be set to, as the deployment's configuration names them.

RoundOpening.description: What a round settled, without the instructions' text.

RoundPipeline.description: What a round's turns wrote in the round log, row by row (docs/instruction.md, 「The round log」).

RoundRead.description: One thing a round read from the brain (docs/instruction.md, 「The round log」).

holds.description: What it holds: the index's words for it where the gate's index lists it, else the name it went in with.

how.description:
`attached` (a piece of the turn's core that went in full), `held` (one that went as a mark, the session
holding that version, or a piece the agent read again through the index at a version the session already
held) or `read` (a piece the agent read itself through the index during the round at a version new to it).

memoryId.description: The brain memory it is, where it is one.

RoundVersion.description: One answer of the program's turns a turn of the process spanned (docs/instruction.md, 「The round log」).

opened.description:
What opened that turn: `handed`, words handed over (the turn's own prompt or words pushed into it), or
`program`, the program on its own (a background task's notice).

text.description: That turn's answer as it wrote it.

Said.description: What an instruction hands a session: a fact, or the words of an order.

SendAnswer.description: What a send came to: carried, refused, or handed to the room's supervisor as the order `handed` numbers.

SendRequest.description: A send asked of the receiver.

tool.description:
The tool's name: `say`, `photo`, `file`, `voice`, `react`, `pin`, `sticker` or `random_draw`, or `speak`, a
spoken talk asked by its words.

SendVerbs.description: The verbs of the road a send naming `via` goes out on in a room; one provider's own are its `can`.

SenderOwner.description: Whether a message's sender is the owner in that room.

Situation.description: A room's situation note as one round read it: its text and whether that round wrote it afresh.

Speaker.description: One speaker among the room's most talkative people.

Spoke.description: Whether a person spoke in a room in a span.

StartRoom.description:
`POST /rooms`: a conversation a chat service starts, a one-to-one with `contact_id` or a group of
`contact_ids` under `title`, in the account `account_id` names, added in a mode as the room it comes to.

accountId.description: The account the conversation is started in; unnamed, the service's own.

title.description: The room's title; a group's, which a group needs.

Sticker.description: A sticker of the record's set, by its emoji, as the set lists it.

StickerSend.description: A sticker of the record's set the signed-in person sends, by its emoji.

account.description: The account the act is for where the console acts for one; refused in another account's private room.

SupervisorAdded.description: `POST /supervisors`: the agency's read of the supervisor, what became of its brain, and its room.

SupervisorRequest.description:
A supervisor added with a room of the console's own, on its one road: `provider` and `model`, with `effort`,
`thinking` and `answerTokens` where it names them, each the provider's own where it does not.

answerTokens.description: The answer ceiling, on the registry's provider.

effort.description: A level of the reasoning policy the model takes.

ownerAccount.description: The account the supervisor belongs to, whose private room its own room is kept as.

repository.description: The repository its items go to, one the agency holds.

thinking.description: `on`, `off`, or none for the provider's own.

SupervisorReset.description: A reset asked of a supervisor: its ranges, whether it only counts, and who asks.

SupervisorRoom.description:
One room a supervisor answers: whether the room names it, or names none and it is the default answerer, and
whether it answers there alone.

Talk.description: A talk's topic and what the owner says.

topic.description:
What the talk is about: `kind` names it, `heading` is its head paragraph and `fields` are the values its
head carries; a caller's own kind needs no code in the receiver.

VoiceBriefing.description: The voice briefing's two switches: the whole briefing, and whether a summary plays by itself.

VoiceBriefingSwitch.description: One of the voice briefing's switches moved: exactly one of the two, as a boolean.

Window.description: How long the default answerer's window in a room has left.

closesAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; null where the room never opened one.

WireError.description: The body every non-2xx answer carries.

info.description: The chat receiver: the rooms and their messages, the rules, rights and windows of each room, the envelope a turn goes out in, and the waking of the agents a room's words, a quiet instruction or a job's end calls for. Every route answers in the common wire format: camelCase keys, times as integers of epoch milliseconds, rooms, messages and people as signed 64-bit integers, lists as pages of items and more, and every failure as a non-2xx answer carrying code and error. The routes a chat provider hands messages over on stand under /chat, as bmo-chat's protocol states them.
